title: SLeeLa parametry — registry of known/supported models
description: Declarative mirror of the built-in registry in parametry.c. Lists supported model NAMES and their declared parameters only. No weights are shipped; a user binding a known name still supplies the actual weights for that family. A user may instead bind a LOCAL model by path (see binding.schema.json).

models.name: sleela-code-compact
models.note: Compact SLeeLa Code LLM (lower 2 GB envelope).

models.name: sleela-code-capable
models.note: Capable SLeeLa Code LLM; larger context.

models.name: sleela-code-large
models.note: Large SLeeLa Code LLM (upper 16 GB envelope).
